leads.posting: Hunar Raises ₹40 Cr To Scale Agentic AI For Frontline Hiring. Hiring thousands of frontline workers (employees who directly provide goods and services to communities) across multiple cities is a coordination-heavy cumbersome task for HR managers. Recruiters have to call prospective employees, follow up on applications, schedule interviews and keep workers informed through onboarding and training. When hiring volumes spike during festive seasons or business expansion, these tasks can quickly become more difficult to solve manually. Bengaluru-based conversational AI startup Hunar.AI is building AI agents to automate these HR workflows. The startup today announced the raise of ₹40 Cr ($4.2 Mn) in its Series A funding round led by Blume Ventures. Other investors like Hyderabad Angels Fund, Together Fund, Seedstars, AVNM Ventures, PhysicsWallah cofounders Prateek Maheshwari and Alakh Pandey, and MediaMint cofounder Aditya Vuchi also participated in the round. Founded in 2022 by Krishna Khandelwal and Shantanu Bhattacharyya, Hunar.AI automates frontline workforce management via its conversational AI agents. These agents help ease various frontline workforce management issues — including hiring, onboarding, training and retention. It is targeting businesses that need to recruit and manage large numbers of workers, often across several locations and regional languages. The startup offers voice AI capabilities in more than 20 languages, including Tamil, Telugu and Kannada. This allows enterprises to communicate with workers in their preferred languages while automating workflows that would otherwise require repeated calls and manual follow-ups. The startup intends to use the fresh capital to strengthen its AI infrastructure, develop its products and bolster its go-to-market strategy. “Frontline workforce management is one of the largest yet most underserved opportunities in enterprise AI. Nouscom • Re-defining innovation Re-defining innovation Nouscom is a next-generation immunotherapy company developing engineered viral vectored vaccines for treatment of cancer. The company has offices, research and manufacturing facilities in Basel, Switzerland and Rome, Italy. LEARN MORE +41 61 201 18 31 +39 06 96 03 62 99 info@nouscom.com www.nouscom.com Empowering the immune response Nouscom’s proprietary immunotherapy platforms utilize a portfolio of uniquely engineered viral vectors optimized for the efficient expression of long strings of tumor neoantigens and comprise a powerful toolkit for the induction of broad and potent anti-tumor T cell responses . The Company’s deep knowledge of vaccine manufacturing, and the platform’s capacity to reliably encode unprecedented numbers of neoantigens is combined with proprietary approaches to neoantigen identification. Our mission is to generate safe, innovative, and potent next-generation cancer immunotherapies that selectively eliminate tumor cells . Our published pre-clinical and clinical data indicate that our approach is able to induce strong immune responses with potential to expand the applicability and efficacy of existing immunotherapies while delivering high levels of safety and tolerability. ( D’Alise et al , Nature Comm, 2019 ; D’Alise et al , Science Translational Medicine, 2022 ; Bechter et al , Cancer Res, 2023 ; Fakih et al , J. Clin Oncology, 2022 ; Leoni & D’Alise et al , Vaccines 2021 ; Leoni et al , Cancer Res, 2020 ). Enhancing cancer-specific cellular immunity With a proprietary portfolio of recombinant viral vectors, that redirect and potentiate anti-tumor cellular immunity to focus on selected immunogenic tumor neoantigens. Cancer immunotherapy based on neoantigens They encode an unprecedented number of tumor neoantigens for the induction and boosting of cancer-specific T cells. Nouscom proprietary viral vectors are engineered to encode multiple tumor neoantigens from a patient’s mutanome, expressed at high levels, irrespective of the order in which the neoantigens are assembled. Nouscom cancer vaccines include: a) an off-the-shelf immunotherapy encoding a large number of shared tumor neoantigens that are generated by frameshifts resulting from mismatch repair deficiency (dMMR)/microsatellite instability (MSI) (Leoni et al , 2020) , and b) and b) a personalized neoantigen vaccine tailored to individual patient mutanomes. Endovax: Targeted oncolytic virus It is delivered locally or systemically and armored with selected immune-modulators for use in solid tumors. Pipeline Our clinical programmes comprise: i) an off-the-shelf’ cancer immunotherapy based on frameshift neoantigens for treatment of mismatch repair deficient (dMMR)/microsatellite instability (MSI) tumors (NOUS-209); and ii) a personalized neoantigen cancer vaccine for treatment of solid tumors (NOUS-PEV). The round also saw participation from Hyderabad Angels Fund, Together Fund, Seedstars, AVNM Ventures, PhysicsWallah co-founders Prateek Maheshwari and Alakh Pandey, and MediaMint co-founder Aditya Vuchi. Hunar.AI will use the funds for building AI infrastructure, product development, and go-to-market expansion. The company is focused on developing specialised AI technology for frontline-intensive industries, where high-volume hiring, geographically distributed teams, and language diversity create operational challenges that conventional HR systems struggle to address. “Frontline workforce management is one of the largest yet most underserved opportunities in enterprise AI. Solving it requires more than applying general-purpose models to existing processes. It demands a deep understanding of industry workflows, multilingual capabilities and technology that can reliably execute tasks at scale,” said Krishna Khandelwal, Co-founder and CEO, Hunar.AI. Founded in 2022 by Krishna Khandelwal and Shantanu Bhattacharyya, Hunar’s platform comprises Hunar Voice and Hunar Connect, which use conversational AI agents to manage workforce workflows through voice, WhatsApp and chat. Workflows include candidate sourcing and screening, interview scheduling, onboarding, training, employee engagement and worker retention. By automating high-volume interactions, the platform helps enterprises manage frontline workforce processes while maintaining communication with candidates and employees across locations. Arpit Agrawal, Partner at Blume Ventures said, “As the world looks to India for lessons in managing these new-age businesses at scale, Hunar is building the AI layer that makes them possible.
